text:
maria: heads up — noticed a step increase in token-level p50 and p95 for /chat/generate after last night's kernel-selector rollout. p50 went from ~82ms -> ~110ms. :eyes:

jon: ugh. can you paste the route-level breakdown? is this across all models or just the 7B variants?

maria: looks concentrated on routes hitting small-seq workloads (seq<=128). model: rwd-7b-q4, most requests routed to kernel-v2.

kevin: did kernel selector start preferring default tiled kernels instead of fused kernels for short sequences? we added the horizon heuristic in the selector last week.

maria: yes — selector logs show horizon_ms=12 bumped choice to tiled for sequences under 40 tokens. infra-bot: uploaded sample profiles to S3: s3://redwood-profiles/1999999000/

sophia: can we check token-level latency waterfall? we need split by: (1) kernel exec, (2) kv cache lookup, (3) batching/wait, (4) network overhead. current dashboard aggregates too much.

maria: current token breakdown for the affected route (from trace): kernel_exec=65ms, kv_lookup=8ms, batching_wait=20ms, net=7ms. previous baseline kernel_exec was ~40ms.

jon: that smells like kernel choice regression. the selector probably picked a non-optimized kernel for short seqs. we should also verify KV cache reuse — if cache miss rate raised, prefix rehydration can inflate kernel exec.

kevin: i instrumented a lightweight route-sampled metric last night: route_sample_pct=2%. sample shows kv_hit_rate dropped from 0.78 -> 0.63 on this route in the 2h window post-rollout. evictions ticked up too.

maria: interesting — eviction spike around 02:12 UTC matching deploy. memory footprint reported 1.25GiB -> 1.6GiB for prefix shard set 14. perhaps tiled kernel uses different KV layout?

sophia: possible. we need these three things: (A) kernel-selection telemetry per decision (why chosen), (B) per-token latency panels split by kernel variant, (C) kv prefix reuse by route and shard. i'll make dashboard tickets.

jon: for (A) can we log the selector decision tags into trace: kernel_variant, selector_score, horizon_ms, cost_estimate? short sample is fine.

kevin: propose quick config to enable sampling and a tiny debug flag:

```
runtime:
  selector_debug_sampling_pct: 0.5
  selector_tags: ["kernel_variant","horizon_ms","seq_len","route"]
  kv_route_sample_pct: 5
```

maria: +1. let's keep sampling low to avoid perf noise. also dump one full profile per 10k requests for the route.

infra-bot: profiler job queued: profile-1999999000-1 (uploaded: s3://redwood-profiles/1999999000/profile-1.pb).

sophia: dashboard plan: create a new 'kernel selector' tab with: waterfall per-token (median+95), stacked by kernel_variant; a table of selector decisions by route; a heatmap of kv_hit_rate vs seq_len; and 'eviction / mem' sparkline per-shard.

kevin: i'll sketch panels. lightweight query examples:

`avg_over_time(token_latency{route="/chat/generate",kernel_variant=~".*"}[5m]) by (kernel_variant)`

`sum(kv_evictions_total) by (shard,route)`

maria: FYI — user-facing SLO for that route is 150ms p90. currently p90 at 180ms for the last 30m. need quick rollback if no fix by EOD. :warning:

jon: rollback plan: revert horizon heuristic (feature flag) -> force fused kernels for seq<=128 for the affected pool. canary to 10% first.

sophia: create a short runbook entry in incidents channel and put a link in the dashboard notes. i'll open a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWINF-3212

maria: thanks. i'll attach sample traces and mark top offending request ids.

kevin: action items for me: enable selector_debug_sampling_pct=0.5, kv_route_sample_pct=5, add selector_tags to traces, update dashboard queries. target: 2h.

jon: i'll prepare rollback flag and test canary. ping me when dash panels land.

sophia: tagging @oncall for visibility. :bell:

dashbot: dashboard created: 'kernel-selector-inspection-1999999000' -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/kernel-selector-inspection-1999999000

maria: perfect. i'll start triage now. :shipit:
